title: 2026 AI Music Prompt Presets — Community-Proven Banger Formulas
description: Copy-paste-ready brief presets compiled from real Suno v6, MiniMax Music 3.0, HappyShrimp 1.0, and Lyria 3.5 community formulas and official docs (Sep 2026). Each preset pre-fills the form and maps to the target engine's paste-box format.
